title: Transformer And VLA Check
plain_reading: Modern models mix parts that may fit analog with parts that still need digital compute and safety logic.
what_this_supports: Static projection and feed-forward layers may be analog candidates.
Attention, normalization, action heads, and safety boundaries need explicit digital handling.
what_this_does_not_prove: It does not support a full-VLA-on-analog claim.
next_actions: Add transformer and VLA scanning to the compiler frontend.
Show blocked model parts with plain reasons.
